findings.title: Pterodactyl Panel Allows Unauthenticated Arbitrary Remote Code Execution (GHSA-24wv-6c99-f843)
findings.summary_md: Pterodactyl Panel prior to version 1.11.11 contains an unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerability (CVE-2025-49132) reachable through the /locales/locale.json endpoint by manipulating the locale and namespace query parameters. The advisory was published by matthewpi on 2025-06-19 and identifies version 1.11.11 as the fix.

findings.title: Fragnesia (CVE-2026-46300) Patches Released
findings.summary_md: AlmaLinux published patched kernels for CVE-2026-46300 on 2026-05-13, the same day William Bowling of V12 Security disclosed Fragnesia with a public proof of concept. The post documents the skb_try_coalesce flaw, the affected distributions, and the module-blacklist mitigation using esp4, esp6, and rxrpc for systems that cannot patch immediately.

findings.title: CVE-2026-46300 (Fragnesia): Linux Kernel ESP-in-TCP LPE FAQ
findings.summary_md: CVE-2026-46300 (Fragnesia) is a local privilege escalation in the Linux kernel XFRM ESP-in-TCP subsystem disclosed on 2026-05-13 by William Bowling of V12 Security, with a public proof of concept that rewrites page-cache files such as /usr/bin/su. Tenable's FAQ, published 2026-05-14, notes the flaw is distinct from Dirty Frag, requires a separate kernel patch, and was not in the CISA KEV catalog as of that date.

findings.title: Metasploit Framework 6.5 Released
findings.summary_md: Rapid7 released Metasploit Framework 6.5 on 2026-07-30, introducing Malleable C2 profile support for Meterpreter HTTP traffic, an MCP server for AI tooling, NTLM relaying upgrades, and MITRE ATT&CK tagging. The release underpins the malleable HTTP profiles and AArch64 reverse-TCP shells highlighted in the August 2026 weekly wrap-up.
